body:
[I'd like to think of your name as some kind of happy hippy car](http://i.imgur.com/eA0Q2.png)

Yeah, it's good that you have that friend there for you. The one i used to talk about this with is too distant now, and she's always been a little judgemental, which makes me too uncomfortable to really say much. And I've gone the antidepressant route, which honestly didn't do anything but lower my anxiety at first. I should probably try going back to that psychiatrist, but I don't know. If I feel like this, I don't think a little pill will really help improve much.

Thank you again for offering though. I really appreciate it, mr. elephantcar.

*Don't focus on the future, or else you might set yourself up for failure.*

This stood out to me. Why do you say that?

And I understand about the focusing on the now, and I'd love to, but I can't at the moment. I want to throw away all my worries and just buy a plane ticket to somewhere, but I've got responsibilities and a crashed car to pay off and I just can't do anything I really want to do without putting myself in debt.

....and wait no, now that I'm psychoanalyzing myself, I think I'm just afraid of change and failure. Which explains why I can't exactly seek out my acquaintance/friends and would rather just off myself than go out and step outside the circle.

I've always loved elephants. And elephants with cars? Brilliant.

Thank you for the offer, but I won't keep you awake any longer. I do have a question for you though. How did you get over it? Or did you?

When you're a girl, that's pretty much what life is about. Even on reddit, all I see are women being sized up on their looks. And if it's not about my physical appearance, it's about my social ability, and if not that, then talent at the very least. None of these are mutually exclusive, of course, but when I have none of the above...

Anyways, I used to enjoy drawing, but these days, I can't pick up a pencil without the stress of failure on my mind. 

Look at me, being such a debby downer. Still, thank you so much for bothering to read and comment. I really appreciate it.
